_comment: English content for service pages. Keyed by the same slug as content/services.json. Build with: python3 scripts/build_pages.py

cctv.name: CCTV Cameras
cctv.lead: Supply and installation of IP and analog CCTV cameras suited to your site and security needs, including DVR/NVR recording devices.
intro: We design the surveillance system around the site itself: the number of points to cover, lighting conditions, distances, and how long recordings must be kept.

We offer IP cameras for modern facilities that need high quality and flexible management, and analog cameras for installations that need a cost-effective, fast deployment. Together we choose the right option for each point.
includes: Site survey to define camera positions and coverage angles.
Supply of IP and analog cameras and accessories as required.
Installation of DVR and NVR recorders and storage setup.
Cable routing, termination, and configuration.
Testing of image and recording quality, and user training.

faq.q: What is the difference between IP and analog cameras?
faq.a: IP cameras send video over a network and offer higher resolution and easier remote management. Analog cameras use dedicated cabling and are usually cheaper for small projects. We recommend the best fit after the site survey.

faq.q: Does the service include recording devices?
faq.a: Yes. We supply DVR or NVR recorders based on the camera type and number of points, and size the storage for the retention period you need.

cctv.keywords: CCTV cameras, CCTV installation Makkah, IP cameras, analog cameras, DVR, NVR, security cameras Saudi Arabia

security-systems.name: Security Surveillance Systems
security-systems.lead: Integrated security surveillance systems for facilities, connecting cameras, recording, and management in one easy-to-operate system.
intro: An effective security system is more than cameras. It is a set of components covering coverage, recording, live viewing, and user permissions.
We design the system to be simple for the security team to operate, and easy to expand when you add new branches or points.
includes: Risk assessment and identification of critical coverage areas.
Supply and installation of surveillance equipment and recording systems.
Live monitoring from a central screen or from your mobile, depending on your needs.
User permission setup and recording retention settings.
Training for the operations team and a short user guide.

faq.q: Can I monitor the system from my phone?
faq.a: Yes, depending on the devices selected. We confirm this in the quotation.
Yes. We design the system so that all branches can be managed from a central location if you wish.

security-systems.keywords: security surveillance systems, integrated security system, facility security Makkah

safety-systems.name: Safety Systems & Equipment
safety-systems.lead: Supply and implementation of safety solutions for sites and facilities, matched to the needs of each location.
intro: Safety is a core part of any facility. We prepare the right systems and devices for each site and coordinate them with the other security and technical systems so they work as one.
Every site has different requirements, so we always start with a survey and define the actual need before proposing a solution.
includes: Site survey and definition of the actual requirement.
Supply of the required safety systems and devices.
Installation and connection according to the approved layout.
Integration with alarm and surveillance systems where needed.
Testing, handover, and post-installation support.

faq.q: Do you provide solutions for existing facilities?
faq.a: Yes. We survey the site and propose the necessary additions or changes, minimizing disruption to operations where possible.

safety-systems.keywords: safety systems, safety equipment, facility safety solutions, Makkah

fire-alarm.name: Fire Alarm & Smoke Detection
fire-alarm.lead: Fire alarm and protection systems tailored to your project requirements. They detect danger early and alert people in time.
intro: An early warning system reduces losses and gives people enough time to evacuate. We choose the detector types (smoke, heat, or others) based on the nature of each area.
We design the detector layout, control panel, and alarm devices, and test the full system before handover.
includes: Site survey to define detector positions and alarm points.
Supply of the control panel, detectors, manual call points, and audible/visual alarms.
Cabling and device installation.
Testing of every point and a full alarm test.
Operation and maintenance guide, with periodic maintenance for the system.

faq.q: Does the installation need maintenance after handover?
faq.a: Yes. Alarm systems need periodic inspection to confirm they are ready to operate. We offer maintenance contracts for this.
Yes. We work to standardize the systems across different sites under one management approach.

fire-alarm.keywords: fire alarm system, smoke detectors, fire alarm Makkah, fire safety

networks.name: Networks & Infrastructure
networks.lead: Data networks, internal internet, and telecom infrastructure, forming a reliable foundation for all your systems.
intro: Every security or technical system depends on a stable network. We design the network according to the number of users and devices, and prepare the infrastructure that connects buildings and departments.
We work on both wired and wireless networks, and prepare surveillance networks so they run fast and steadily without interruptions.
includes: Requirements study and network design, including connection points.
Cable routing and installation of distribution panels and switches.
Installation of Wi-Fi access points and coverage planning.
A dedicated network for surveillance and control systems.
Network configuration and speed and stability testing.

faq.q: Do you only install wireless networks?
faq.a: No. We implement both wired and wireless networks and define the right mix for each location.

faq.q: Can you prepare the network for a new project before finishing works?
faq.a: Yes. Early coordination with the contractor saves time and cost.

networks.keywords: structured cabling, wired and wireless networks, internal internet, IT infrastructure, Makkah

access-control.name: Access Control & Intercom
access-control.lead: Programming and implementation of access control and intercom systems, to manage people movement and keep operations safe and smooth.
intro: An access control system decides who can enter which area and when, and records every entry and exit. We program the system according to the permissions of each user group.
Intercom systems let visitors be identified before a door is opened, and can be integrated with the control and surveillance systems to work together.
includes: Identifying entry and exit points and the right control method.
Supply of electric gates, locks, and card or fingerprint readers as required.
Supply and installation of intercom devices.
Programming of permissions, time schedules, and access reports.
Integration with surveillance where needed.

faq.q: Can I add users or change permissions later?
faq.a: Yes. The system is built to be managed and updated easily as your facility changes.
Options include cards, fingerprints, and access codes, depending on the devices selected. We explain the best choices during the survey.

access-control.keywords: access control, intercom systems, access control Makkah, electric gates, fingerprint access

cctv-maintenance.name: CCTV Maintenance
cctv-maintenance.lead: Maintenance and technical support for surveillance systems, keeping them ready and avoiding gaps in coverage when a fault occurs.
intro: A stopped camera means an unmonitored area. We provide preventive maintenance visits that include inspection, cleaning, and settings checks, and corrective maintenance when a fault occurs.
We monitor the condition of cameras and recording devices and inform you of any issue before it becomes a full outage.
includes: Periodic inspection of all cameras and recording devices.
Lens cleaning and adjustment of coverage angles and lighting.
Checks of storage, recording, and retention periods.
Repair of faults and supply of spare parts when needed.
A report after each visit explaining the condition and actions taken.
forWho: Any facility with an existing surveillance system

faq.q: Do you maintain systems installed by other companies?
faq.a: Yes, after we survey the existing systems and confirm their condition.

faq.q: Is maintenance under a contract or on request?
faq.a: Both options are available: regular visits under a contract, or on-request service. We explain the difference in the quotation.

cctv-maintenance.keywords: CCTV maintenance, camera maintenance Makkah, security system maintenance

integrated-security.name: Integrated Security Systems
integrated-security.lead: Integration of surveillance, security, access control, and alarm systems into one platform, designed for each facility's needs.
intro: When systems run separately, information gets lost and you end up with many control panels. We connect the systems so monitoring is easier and decisions can be made faster.
We start by defining the actual need of the facility and build the solution in stages that can grow in the future.
includes: Requirements analysis and identification of the systems to integrate.
Design of the integrated platform and its layouts.
Supply and installation of the systems and their connection.
Programming of integration rules and shared alerts.
Team training and operations guide.

faq.q: Can we start with part of the system and expand later?
faq.a: Yes. We design the solution so it accepts additions later without rebuilding everything.

integrated-security.keywords: integrated security systems, security systems integration, security platform Makkah

technical-support.name: Technical Support for Companies
technical-support.lead: Operational and technical support for companies and facilities, so your systems run efficiently every day and your team can rely on them.
intro: After installation, systems need someone to monitor them and solve problems quickly. We provide technical support covering faults, questions, and changes.
Our goal is to keep your business running without interruption due to a technical fault.
includes: Receiving and tracking support requests.
Resolving faults remotely or on site, depending on the case.
Changing settings and adding users and permissions.
Training staff on how to use the systems.
Periodic reports on system status.

faq.q: How do I request technical support?
faq.a: Through WhatsApp, by phone, or through the quotation form on the website.

technical-support.keywords: technical support for companies, security systems support, Makkah

maintenance-contracts.name: Maintenance Contracts
maintenance-contracts.lead: Support and maintenance contracts for security, technical, and infrastructure systems, with a clear plan that keeps systems ready and running.
intro: A maintenance contract turns maintenance from an emergency cost into an organized plan. We agree with you on the number of visits, the scope of coverage, and the response level.
The contract covers the security, technical, and infrastructure systems we installed, or systems managed by other providers after a survey.
includes: Preventive maintenance visits on an agreed schedule.
Response priority for faults as defined in the contract.
Periodic reports on the status of the systems.
Supply of spare parts as agreed.
An annual review of the systems with suggested improvements.
forWho: Facilities that depend on their systems every day

faq.a: The number of systems and points, the number of visits, and the response level required. We prepare a detailed quotation after the survey.

faq.q: Does the contract include spare parts?
faq.a: This is defined in the contract terms as agreed with the client.

maintenance-contracts.keywords: security system maintenance contracts, camera maintenance contract, technical support contracts, Makkah

project-management.name: Project Management
project-management.lead: Management and delivery of systems, IT, telecom, and surveillance projects, from planning to handover.
intro: A large project needs coordination between several parties and clear timelines. We handle planning, execution, and follow-up through to handover.
We follow a clear methodology: requirements study, solution design, supply and installation, testing, and then support and maintenance.
includes: Preparing the project plan, timeline, and scope of work.
Coordinating the different parties on site.
Following up on supply and installation and monitoring quality.
Testing and handover with the required documents.
A closing report and a post-handover support plan.
forWho: Companies carrying out expansions or new branches
Facilities with more than one contractor

faq.q: Can you work alongside another contractor on the same project?
faq.a: Yes. We coordinate between the parties to ensure a complete handover.

project-management.keywords: IT project management, technical project management, surveillance project delivery, Makkah
